test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 21th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

All musicians are doctors. Some doctors are pilots. No pilots is surgeons.

Conclusions

I. Some doctors are not surgeons.

II. All surgeons are not pilots.
solution:
Given Statements:

All musicians are doctors.

Some doctors are pilots.

No pilot is a surgeon.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdefae1e067f19aa3d5d83ccb6e09b27b636ded26aeb8051252e09df50532006.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some doctors are not surgeons - **True** (Because the part of doctors that are pilots cannot be surgeons, as no pilot is a surgeon).

II. All surgeons are not pilots - **True** (Because "No pilot is a surgeon" is a negative universal statement, which implies its converse "No surgeon is a pilot" or "All surgeons are not pilots" is also true).

So, Both I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
